findings.title: Successful recovery-code validation never consumes the code
findings.body: This validator only checks whether the submitted code is present and leaves `myUser.recoveryCodes` unchanged. Consequently, the same recovery code remains valid for every subsequent login, violating the one-time-use guarantee and allowing an attacker who obtains a code to replay it indefinitely. Consume or remove the matched code on successful validation, and cover replay rejection with a test.
